steps.text: Soften the pepper and onion in olive oil until sweet and beginning to char.
Stir in garlic and smoked paprika until the pan smells toasty.
Add tomatoes, season, and simmer until the sauce mounds on a spoon.
Make five wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites set but yolks wobble.
Scatter with feta and cilantro. Bring the whole skillet and plenty of bread to the table.
